scope: Repair only the post-execution world evidence identity contract proven unsatisfiable by the independent Ubuntu Verifier. Runtime, world runner, test files, P7 gates, Harness policy and canonical acceptance are unchanged. Distinct tests with the same basename must remain distinct through their target path; duplicate full stage identity must still fail closed.

design_brief.root_cause: validate.py asserts global uniqueness of step.name, but RUN_WORLD_REGRESSION_TESTS.ps1 intentionally derives headless test step names from basenames. Distinct discovered targets may legally share a basename. Coverage is already path-based via target Counter, so short-name uniqueness is neither necessary nor satisfiable.
design_brief.selected_design: Define world stage identity as the immutable tuple (kind, target, name). Require uniqueness of that full identity and retain the independent len(steps)==len(discovered)+5 count, exact target Counter, P7.4 phase order and aggregate position checks. Add fail-closed unit tests proving same name/different targets is accepted and exact duplicate identity is rejected.
